stem:
A coach is ordering shirts for a team.

• The coach pays a one-time fee of $24.
• The coach also pays $8 for each shirt ordered.

Which function can be used to find c, the total amount the coach pays in dollars when k shirts are ordered?
visual_elements: The image shows a math problem with text describing a scenario where a coach orders shirts and pays a one-time fee and a per-shirt cost. Four answer choices are given with functions representing the total amount paid based on the number of shirts.
